_comment: Names the game gives people who are not racers, plain ones of no time or place: a setting gives its own with
"replace" (the street rods' streetrod/text/names.json). Whoever calls about a car the player advertised, who sells
parts in the paper, and the stand-in racers of an event nobody on the street can enter.
names.people.men/women: a private seller of a car, met when the player talks to them (their sex is the pool's).
names.salesmen.men/women: a dealer's salesman, one per dealer.
names.clerks.men/women: whoever is behind a part shop's counter, one per shop (a shop's own clerk in its data goes first).
names.car_buyers.women: the names of names.car_buyers that are women's, for how they talk when the player calls them back.

names.car_buyers: a man from out of town
